description: Source code for the radio_zmq_tx_stream class, implementing ZeroMQ transmission stream with channel management, alignment, and data transmission functionalities.

classes.name: radio_zmq_tx_stream
classes.description: Manages ZeroMQ transmission channels, handles start/stop, alignment, and data transmission.

methods.name: radio_zmq_tx_stream
methods.description: Constructor initializing channels based on configuration, setting up ZeroMQ context and notification handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all channels with an initial timestamp.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns channels to a given timestamp within a timeout, returns true if at least one channel is in the past.

methods.name: transmit
methods.description: Transmits data after aligning stream; converts data to complex float and sends via channels.
